posts.text: NFL catch-up price drop is LIVE (9:45 pm). It is running on Monday night (CIN-WAS) and Wednesday's Packers game (GB-LAR), and every future NFL book gets it automatically. What it does: when the public is provably buying a side below our price and that side is behind our other sides, the book now moves the row down to the buyers' price instead of sitting above them. It can move the whole row (not just half) when the gap is 2 cents or more or the buyers' prices still add to 1.03 or better. Worst case: it adds no contracts, it only gives up the price gap, about $3 to $40 a side per move, two moves a side at most; loss limits unchanged. Reload check: all orders kept, none cancelled. Tonight's Vikings game is untouched (the rule is pregame only). One switch turns it off.
